analysis.category: Agentic 视频生产 / 多工具编排
analysis.oneLiner: 把视频生产拆成 12 条流水线、52 个工具和 500+ agent skills；真正值得看的不是“AI 做视频”，而是多步骤创作任务如何被工具化、审计化和失败接管。
analysis.whyItMatters: OpenMontage 把脚本、素材、剪辑、声音、封面和发布前检查串成 agentic production studio。对内容、增长和开发者关系团队来说，它提供了一个可拆解样本：哪些步骤适合交给 Agent，哪些步骤必须保留人工品控。短期价值在于把重复素材处理和版本生成自动化，长期风险在于版权、品牌一致性、模型成本和失败回滚。
analysis.engineeringRead: 阅读顺序建议从 pipeline 配置、工具注册、素材目录、agent skill 边界和失败日志开始，再看具体模型适配。不要先复制整套系统；先验证单条视频从输入素材到成片的可回放性、人工接管点和每分钟成片成本。
architectureSignals: 架构机制：视频创作工作流被拆成可调用工具、技能文件、素材状态和流水线调度，核心是编排层而不是单个生成模型。
适用团队：有稳定内容模板、素材来源可控、审稿流程明确的增长、品牌、开发者内容和内部培训团队。
落地路径：先选一类低风险素材做“脚本 -> 粗剪 -> 字幕 -> 封面”旁路流水线，只输出候选稿，不自动发布。
生产风险：版权素材、品牌调性、人物肖像、模型费用、长任务中断和错误成片都需要前置治理。
决策问题：它能否降低单条内容的制作周期和返工率，而不是把剪辑问题转成更难排查的 Agent 问题？
观察信号：端到端完成率、人工修改轮次、单条视频成本、素材复用率、失败任务可解释性和审稿通过率。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 把推荐检索从“独立索引 + 下游排序”推进到 index-as-model：索引本身承载可训练表征和服务优化，官方披露吞吐和成本效率大幅改善，核心信号是召回层正在被模型化和 GPU serving 化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 推荐候选池巨大，传统召回索引和排序模型目标不一致，导致离线召回提升难转成线上排序收益，同时 GPU/CPU 成本被多阶段架构放大。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 将索引看作模型的一部分，统一训练、索引构建、检索服务和排序目标，让召回阶段直接学习下游目标，并用 GPU serving 提升高维候选检索效率。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 recall@K、后续排序胜率、吞吐、P95/P99 延迟、单位查询成本、索引刷新时延和线上 CTR/CVR/停留等核心指标。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴“召回目标与排序目标对齐”的设计：先做影子召回和 replay，对比传统 ANN/倒排索引的候选覆盖与线上漏斗贡献。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模小、召回链路简单或缺少 GPU serving/在线实验能力时，不应直接复制 index-as-model；复杂度会超过收益。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 将企业 RAG 拆成多 Agent 检索和 sufficient-context 判断，关键不是多轮检索本身，而是让系统知道证据是否足够再回答。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索/RAG 常在权限、跨语料、多跳问题和证据不足时生成似是而非的答案，用户很难判断回答是否建立在足够上下文上。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 用查询规划、检索、证据充分性判断和回答生成的多 Agent 工作流，把“继续找证据还是回答”变成显式决策。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 看 answer correctness、引用命中率、拒答率、二次查询率、权限误召、平均检索轮次、延迟和人工评审一致性。
interpretation.borrowable: 可用于企业知识库和客服搜索：先加 sufficient-context gate，再逐步扩展到多语料、多跳检索。
interpretation.boundary: 如果权限系统和评测集不可靠，多 Agent RAG 会放大错误证据；不适合直接接入高风险合规问答。

interpretation.borrowable: 推荐/广告团队可把推理预算做成策略变量，而不是固定每个候选都走同一模型。
interpretation.boundary: 没有稳定价值预估、预算控制和在线实验平台时，自适应推理容易制造不可解释的线上波动。

items.title: From Clicks to Conversions: Architecting Shopping Conversion Candidate Generation at Pinterest
items.summary: Pinterest 购物广告候选生成从点击目标转向转化目标，核心是让召回阶段直接面向下游商业转化，而不是只服务点击代理指标。

interpretation.businessProblem: 购物广告如果只优化点击，候选会偏向低意向兴趣，难以提升购买和广告主 ROI。

interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 关注候选 survival rate、转化候选覆盖、CTR/CVR、ROAS、广告主预算消耗、排序漏斗通过率和线上业务指标。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合把召回目标从点击代理指标迁移到业务终局指标，并在召回到精排之间记录候选存活路径。
interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、归因噪声大或正样本稀疏的业务，直接训练转化召回会引入偏差。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 把推荐检索从“独立索引 + 下游排序”推进到 index-as-model：索引本身承载可训练表征和服务优化，官方披露吞吐和成本效率大幅改善，核心信号是召回层正在被模型化和 GPU serving 化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 推荐候选池巨大，传统召回索引和排序模型目标不一致，导致离线召回提升难转成线上排序收益，同时 GPU/CPU 成本被多阶段架构放大。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 将索引看作模型的一部分，统一训练、索引构建、检索服务和排序目标，让召回阶段直接学习下游目标，并用 GPU serving 提升高维候选检索效率。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 recall@K、后续排序胜率、吞吐、P95/P99 延迟、单位查询成本、索引刷新时延和线上 CTR/CVR/停留等核心指标。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴“召回目标与排序目标对齐”的设计：先做影子召回和 replay，对比传统 ANN/倒排索引的候选覆盖与线上漏斗贡献。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模小、召回链路简单或缺少 GPU serving/在线实验能力时，不应直接复制 index-as-model；复杂度会超过收益。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 将企业 RAG 拆成多 Agent 检索和 sufficient-context 判断，关键不是多轮检索本身，而是让系统知道证据是否足够再回答。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索/RAG 常在权限、跨语料、多跳问题和证据不足时生成似是而非的答案，用户很难判断回答是否建立在足够上下文上。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 用查询规划、检索、证据充分性判断和回答生成的多 Agent 工作流，把“继续找证据还是回答”变成显式决策。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 看 answer correctness、引用命中率、拒答率、二次查询率、权限误召、平均检索轮次、延迟和人工评审一致性。
interpretation.borrowable: 可用于企业知识库和客服搜索：先加 sufficient-context gate，再逐步扩展到多语料、多跳检索。
interpretation.boundary: 如果权限系统和评测集不可靠，多 Agent RAG 会放大错误证据；不适合直接接入高风险合规问答。

interpretation.boundary: 没有稳定价值预估、预算控制和在线实验平台时，自适应推理容易制造不可解释的线上波动。

interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、归因噪声大或正样本稀疏的业务，直接训练转化召回会引入偏差。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.
